attempts.summary: Repaired node1’s upload endpoint on TCP/8080. It atomically publishes unique receipts for bodies up to 65,536 bytes, returns 413 for larger bodies, cleans up interrupted uploads, and returns 404 for other paths. The legacy receipt remains unchanged. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 were retained.
